ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values with approximately 30-40% high-intensity (white/yellow-white) pixel clusters distributed along the distal and upper margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous non-linear boundary with high-frequency serrations; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude variation is consistently observed across the entire horizontal extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile along the distal margins, exhibiting a positive upward gradient towards the lobe tips.
